sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Essence Theft T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Torment Pulse, vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery. Ultimate (Borrowed Decree) is available from Torment Pulse.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Torment Pulse completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Torment Pulse completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 11 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Spirit Lifesteal, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-31,200 (levels 17-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Jar of Dead T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Grasping Hands, damage) grows from 179 to 335. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Toxic Bullets.

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Toxic Bullets, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you. Takes vitality from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus. Replaces Extra Regen: sell it when you buy this.

items.name: Escalating Resilience
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Your gun hits about 10 times a second, so this fills up in about 3s.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | With 2 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 159s; 20% off is 31.8s per full rotation.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 31,200-48,800 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Grasping Hands T3, Borrowed Decree T3.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 46 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Leech
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.
sections.desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows, hexes and burns like Infernus's.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They stun you as you walk in.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep stopping you in their face.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Enchanter's Emblem for this, or Escalating Resilience if it's gone.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 20,800 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 48 to Grasping Hands's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Stamina Mastery: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
